assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: cinematic 16:9 full-bleed conference chapter divider. Behind it, a branching set of ordinary physical dispatch shelves carries many nearly identical small parcels into deep perspective, a subtle repeated burgundy seal detail connecting them. One slim unmarked credential card lies on the bench, not an oversized key. The machinery is functioning normally. Carefully designed warm amber practical lights, charcoal steel, worn paper, restrained plum shadows and photographic film grain. Portrait about 5:8, all important objects safely inside the middle 80 percent so the image can crop into a 38-percent-wide 16:9 slide sidebar.
